title: gantry why --json (schema v1)
description: Replay of the last run's gate/decision trace from the write-ahead ledger (runs.jsonl). Published per plan 'Versioning & compatibility': additive fields are free, consumers ignore unknown ones, and removing or retyping a field is a major bump (a new file, why-v2.json).

found.description: True when the ledger holds at least one run; false (with run: null) on an empty or missing ledger.

run.description: The most recent run: the write-ahead OPEN intent plus its terminal verdict when one landed. null when found is false.

ts.description: Unix milliseconds when the intent was written (run start).

args.description: The intercepted argv tail, subcommand first.

sha.description: Commit sha the run was for.

cwd_rel.description: Caller's directory relative to the repo root.

gate.description: GitGate inputs as captured at decision time.

reason.description: Why the decision was made; empty on the eligible-remote path.

verdict.description: Terminal verdict; null while the run is in flight or lost. Agents branch on verdict.verdict (the AS-2 failure class) without parsing logs.

exit_code.description: The faithful exit code the caller saw.

durations_ms.description: Duration breakdown; absent when the pipeline recorded none.

failure_class.description: The failure taxonomy class the run died of (plan §Component 5); null when no class was recorded — passes, infra, cancels, superseded, local runs, uninstrumented producers, in-flight and lost runs, and every pre-taxonomy record whose entry lacks the field.

orphaned.description: True when the intent never got a verdict: in flight, or a lost run (gantry doctor reports the latter).

ledger.description: Health of the ledger the answer was read from.

entries.description: Paired runs read from the ledger.

skipped_lines.description: Unparseable lines skipped (torn final line, truncated record) — diagnostics answer from what parsed.

unmatched_verdicts.description: Verdict records whose run_id matched no intent.

runlog_path.description: Absolute path of the ledger the answer was read from.
